newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer sees Q2 economic upturn continuing in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer sees Q2 economic upturn continuing in Q3.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said on Thursday that he expected the upturn seen in the German economy in the second quarter to continue in the third quarter but possibly at a slower pace.
"We have found ourselves in a renewed upturn since the second quarter which continued in the summer months, albeit perhaps at a somewhat slower pace," Tietmeyer told reporters.
The Bundesbank president also said he expected the German economy to grow by more than two percent in real terms in 1997 and that inflation would remain low.
"I will not make a precise forecast, but I expect real growth of over two percent in 1997 without... a notable increase in inflation," he said.
